Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_WMG1_UT;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/b37c3847-9357-4858-bd23-9f028bdd7027/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/c17b5eb9-63f0-43f1-9b23-dd40729aa8c5/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_WMG1_UT
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
where dc.customerid in (Select distinct customerID from DW.DimCustomer DC
    WHERE DC.BankSK = 1
    AND DC.currentindicator = 1
    AND DC.CustomerSK IN(
        Select distinct CustomerSK from dw.dimwealthmanagementgrouplist wmg))
